fusions.name: Final Cut
fusions.desc: Cuts down through a weakened enemy, which deals 26 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Flensing Arc
fusions.desc: A wide stripping cut that deals 7 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles ahead, with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Flukes Up
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrimshaw Cleaver
fusions.desc: Conjures a cleaver of carved bone. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your maximum health by 10, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
